description: This file defines a Dart class representing a task item in a task management application. It includes enums for task priority and status, and a class TaskItem with fields, constructors, serialization, and copying methods.

classes.name: TaskItem
classes.description: Immutable class representing a task item with properties such as id, title, description, due date, priority, status, project reference, tags, timestamps, reminders, and completion date. Includes methods for copying, JSON serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the TaskItem with optional modifications for specified fields.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a TaskItem instance from a JSON map, decoding timestamps and enums.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the TaskItem instance to a JSON map with timestamp and enum conversions.
